rounds.text: Pramara Promotions Ltd exhibits robust top-line and bottom-line expansion, with 5-year compounded sales growth at 22% and compounded profit growth reaching an impressive 86% [E14, E17]. This strong operational momentum is further validated by recent performance, as trailing twelve-month sales growth accelerates to 44% and profit growth reaches 77% [E16, E19]. Valuation multiples remain remarkably modest compared to broader industry benchmarks; the stock trades at a P/E of 17.76x and a P/B of 1.48x, sitting well below sector medians of 25.58x and 2.22x respectively [E6, E7]. Moreover, intrinsic value calculations via discounted cash flow place the fair value at Rs 292 per share against a market price of Rs 130, offering a substantial margin of safety of 55.5% [E38, E39]. The reverse DCF indicates that today's depressed price only implies a 6.8% earnings growth rate, which stands in stark contrast to the base-case assumption of 18.0% [E40]. Finally, profitability metrics outpace sector medians significantly, with the company delivering an ROCE of 12.02% against a sector benchmark of 6.24% [E10]. Conceded: the stock has suffered a 39% decline in share price over the past year alongside negative operating and free cash flows [E20, E28, E29].
